content: नाग {%a.%} (-गी|{%f.%}) .²1 Serpentine, formed of snakes, snaky. .²2 Elephantine. .{@-गः@} [न गच्छति इत्यगः न अगो नागः] .²1 A snake in general, particularly the cobra; नासुरोऽयं न वा नागः <ls>Ki. 15. 12</ls>. .²2 A fabulous serpent-demon or semi-divine being, having the face of a man and the tail of a serpent, and said to inhabit the Pātāla; अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानाम् <ls>Bg. 10. 29</ls>; <ls>R. 15. 83</ls>. .²3 An elephant; दिङ्नागानां पथि परिहरन् स्थूलहस्तावलेपान् <ls>Me. 14</ls>, <ls n="Me.">36</ls>; <ls>Śi. 4. 63</ls>; <ls>V. 4. 25</ls>. .²4 A shark. .²5 A cruel or tyrannical person. .²6 (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) Any pre-eminent or distinguished person, {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} पुरुषनागः. .²7 A cloud. .²8 A peg projecting from a wall to hang anything upon. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of several plants as Mesua Roxburghii, Rottlera Tictoria, Piper betel; (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>नागचाफा, नागकेशर, पानवेल, नागरमोथा</ns> <ab>etc.</ab>); <ls>Bhāg. 8. 2. 18</ls>; <ls>Rām. 7. 42. 4</ls>. .²10 One of the five vital airs of the body, that which is expelled by eructation. .²11 The number ‘seven’. .²12 A trumpet (see नागवेला). .{@-गम्@} .²1 Tin. .²2 Lead. .²3 One of the astronomical periods (Karaṇas) called ध्रुव. .²4 The effects of that period on anything done during it. .²5 The asterism called आश्लेषा. .²6 A captivating act of females (स्त्रीबन्धः), gesticulation; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .²7 A kind of coitus; <ls>Nm.</ls> .{@-गी@} .²1 A female Nāga. .²2 A female elephant;
